messages.shortUrlPendingSave: Save this link to generate the short URL.

tooltips.slug: Immutable random short code — the public URL path. Generated on save; cannot be changed afterwards (the URL may already be printed in emails/posts).
tooltips.targetUrl: Where visitors are redirected (302). Query params on the short URL (fbclid, gclid, utm_*) are forwarded to this URL automatically, so ad attribution survives the hop. WhatsApp targets (wa.me / api.whatsapp.com) get special handling: the visitor id is embedded invisibly into the pre-filled text so the resulting conversation is attributed to this link — include a text parameter with a visible message.
tooltips.eventCode: TrackingEvent code recorded on every click (default link_clicked). Use a specific code (e.g. promo_qr_scanned) to segment campaigns; deactivate the code's Event Type row to mute recording while keeping the redirect alive.
tooltips.isActive: When off, the link stops redirecting entirely (404) — use it to kill a dead campaign. To keep redirecting but stop recording, deactivate the Event Type instead.
tooltips.shortUrl: The public URL to share. Uses the dedicated short-link domain when configured (trackingLinkDomain), keeping the CRM's own domain out of public links.
tooltips.totalClicks: Convenience counter — includes preview-bot hits (WhatsApp/Slack unfurls flagged isLikelyBot in the event payload). The Events panel below is the source of truth.
tooltips.teams: Defaults to the tracking source's teams when left empty. Determines which users can see this link.
tooltips.tenant: Derived from teams via Tenant.baseUserTeam. Must match the tracking source's tenant.
tooltips.trackingSource: Source the click events attribute to (same tenant; not CRM (Internal) — link clicks arrive over HTTP). Its 'Auto-create Unknown Codes' setting gates new event codes.
